# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::side_panel`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The side panel host (`layout.side-panel`, D149): one column on the app's glass layer that shows
one of several panels by key. The panels' contents are the app's.

[`Ui::side_panel`](../ui.md#method.Ui.side_panel) draws the card (the app's glass layer, whatever the window's state: R13, the
widget names no preset), then runs `content`
once, for the shown panel, in the rect inside the 1 px [`RING`](side_panel.md#constant.RING) and the [`PAD`](side_panel.md#constant.PAD) of 10. The shown panel runs under
[`Ui::keep_alive`](../ui.md#method.Ui.keep_alive); every other key of [`SidePanelOptions::keys`](side_panel.md#structfield.SidePanelOptions.keys) is only marked alive, so a
hidden panel's scroll offset, text edits and other retained state survive however many frames
it is not drawn. Hidden panels draw nothing and emit no node. A panel stays alive once it has
been shown or listed, until the app ends it with [`Ui::end_keep_alive`](../ui.md#method.Ui.end_keep_alive).

A change of [`SidePanelOptions::panel`](side_panel.md#structfield.SidePanelOptions.panel) shows the new panel with the drawer motion: its
content fades in ([`SHOW_OPACITY`](side_panel.md#constant.SHOW_OPACITY)) while it slides in from [`SHOW_SLIDE_FROM`](side_panel.md#constant.SHOW_SLIDE_FROM) px to its place
([`SHOW_SLIDE`](side_panel.md#constant.SHOW_SLIDE), dropped under Reduced). The first frame of a host does not animate; a show in
flight restarts from the look it has. The card does not move (the source animates the panel's
own view, not the card: [`SidePanelOptions::card_moves`](side_panel.md#structfield.SidePanelOptions.card_moves) makes the card and ring take the slide
and fade too), and a hide snaps: the old panel is gone on the frame of the change. A show moves
no focus (the app knows the first control).

The card's text limit (D12): a text cannot be cut by a rounded clip, so the host keeps the
content [`RING`](side_panel.md#constant.RING) + [`PAD`](side_panel.md#constant.PAD) (11) from the edge, more than the radius of 8.

**Fields**

- <a id="structfield.SidePanelOptions.panel"></a>`pub panel: u64`

  The key of the panel that is shown.

- <a id="structfield.SidePanelOptions.keys"></a>`pub keys: &'a [u64]`

  Every panel's key, so the hidden ones stay alive. `panel` need not be repeated.

- <a id="structfield.SidePanelOptions.glass"></a>`pub glass: GlassLayer`

  The glass layer the card draws.

- <a id="structfield.SidePanelOptions.under"></a>`pub under: [f32; 4]`

  What the card is composed over (premultiplied); see
  [`ToolbarOptions::under`](toolbar.md#structfield.ToolbarOptions.under).

- <a id="structfield.SidePanelOptions.name"></a>`pub name: &'a str`

  The accessible name of the group (the shown panel's title).

- <a id="structfield.SidePanelOptions.card_moves"></a>`pub card_moves: bool`

  The card and its ring take the show's slide and fade with the content. Off by default: the
  source's animation is on the panel's own view, and the card stays still.
